# Project Maya — Technical Summary

## What it is
Project Maya is a free, open-source local inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer hardware, with its own quantized model packs ("Maya-S/M/L/XS") plus community EXL3/GGUF options. It serves an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API and a browser dashboard.
